decisions.name: 林慶台
decisions.sourceCredit: P1340; own work; CC BY-SA 3.0 metadata

stageReview.eyes: FAIL: only blue event backdrop visible; neither eye is in the revealed region
stageReview.nose: FAIL: backdrop and only a sliver of hair, no nose
stageReview.mouth: FAIL: face is not visible, despite the mouth stage label
stageReview.chin: FAIL: a partial upper face appears only; mouth and chin not fully exposed
stageReview.full: FAIL: target face low and partly clipped; a second person's face is clearly visible at lower left

decisions.visualEvidence: Opened immutable GitHub reveal-sheet-01.jpg, contact-sheet-01.jpg, and manual-source-sheet-01.jpg and inspected actual pixels. This crop fails all meaningful reveal stages and contains another face. Source photo itself is a group photo, not automatically disqualified if an isolated, usable crop can be made.
decisions.nextAction: Do not use this gameSha256. Trial a single tighter lower crop from the exact cached source (proposed box [720,880,1320,1600]) with new five-stage boundaries; treat proposal as unapproved until actual pixels are inspected.

decisions.name: 陳湘琪

stageReview.eyes: PASS: both eyes visible in first stage
stageReview.mouth: PASS: lips visible, microphone does not obstruct
stageReview.chin: PASS: lower face and chin visible
stageReview.full: PASS: single clear portrait, no second face or facial watermark

decisions.rightsEvidence: Commons file description and upload history claim that the source CNA YouTube video was CC BY 3.0; no independent archived or direct video-license confirmation found. Commons tag alone is insufficient under the project's strict rights gate.
decisions.identityEvidence: Commons caption explicitly names Chen Shiang-chyi and Wikidata Q5090886 matches; no separate original-video frame-by-frame identity confirmation recorded.
decisions.nextAction: Keep rights hold until original CNA video CC license and identity are independently evidenced; do not integrate merely because crop looks good.

notes: No changes to main, official question banks, creators, or Pages.
Never carry a rejected crop's review status to a new SHA.
Re-check source and QA before release; candidate visual acceptance does not imply rights acceptance.
